name: Example Tablet X1

roms.changelog: Initial build. Removes MDM, unlocks launcher, wallpaper and system settings.

flashingGuide: Backup all data — flashing erases the device.
Enable Developer Options and OEM unlocking (if present) in Settings.
Unlock the bootloader via fastboot (model-specific — see device notes).
Flash the ROM zip using fastboot or a custom recovery (TWRP).
Reboot and set up the ROM.
warnings: Unlocking may violate the terms of the government scheme under which this device was issued — proceed at your own responsibility.
Incorrect flashing can permanently damage (brick) the device.
